advanced-filter-description: Hueyi tlachipahualiztli mitzcahuilia xictlahcuilo ce tlahtolli tlen quipia inin tequitiltin: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ce cahcahualli quinxeloa tequitiltin. Huel tiquinchipahuas mochi monemac tlaltin ica intocayo ihuan impatiuh. Machiyotl: Field1 == Value1. Tlanonotzaliztli: Intla tlaltin noso patiuhtin quipiah cahcahualli, xiquintzacuati ica zan ce tlahtolmachiyotl. Machiyotl: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Inic ticpanos zan ce tlanahuatilmachiotl (' \/), huel tictequihuis \. Machiyotl: Field1 == I\'m. Noihqui huel ticnelos miyac tlamantli. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Mochipa mochi tequitiltin mocaquih itech opochtli hasta yecma. Huel ticpatlas tlatecpanaliztli ica tiquintlalis tlatzacuatin. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Noihqui huel tictemos tlahtoltlaltin ica regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - amatlapaltin tlen quipiah ce machiotl namictih ica *<color>* noso *<name>*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amatlapaltin tlen tlamizqueh ipan *<n>* tonaltin itech axcan. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ quinnextia mochi amatlapaltin tlen ya opanoc intlamiliztonal.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amatlapaltin tlachihualtin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amatlapaltin patlaltin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - mochi amatlapaltin pixcalco ihuan amo pixcalco
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - campa *<field>* cah ce itech `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noso `__predicate_member__`. Xiclalili `-` iixpan *<field>* inic tictemos amo oncayotl ipan inon tlalli (machiyotl `has:-due` quitemoa amatlapaltin amo tlamiliztonalli).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - campa *<sort-name>* cah ce itech `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noso `__predicate_modified__`. Inic tictecpanas temoc, xiclalili `-` iixpan tlatecpanaliztocayotl.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - campa *<n>* cah ce positivo tlapoualli tlen quimati amatlapaltin tlapoualli tlanextililo ipan sesen amatl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Tequitiltin san se monepanoah ica *OR*. Amatlapaltin namictih ica ce tlamantli mocuepah.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` quincuepaz amatlapaltin ipan ce tocatlahtolli itocayo *Blocked* noso *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Tequitiltin iyoca monepanoah ica *AND*. Zan amatlapaltin namictih ica mochi iyoca tlamantli mocuepah. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` quincuepa zan amatlapaltin ipan tocatlahtolli *Available* ica machiotl *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Tonaltin huel motlaliah quemeh positivo noso negativo tlapoualli, noso ica `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` noso `__predicate_year__` para axcan cahuitl.

import-board-zip: Xicaquiti .zip tlanamactli quipia huapalli JSON tlanamactin ihuan huapalli itoca tlapiyalizcaltin ica tlanamictiltin
support-info-only-for-logged-in-users: Tlapalehuiliztli tlanonotzaliztli zan calaquitoqueh tlacame huel quittah.
accessibility-info-not-added-yet: Huel calaquiliztli tlanonotzaliztli amo oc mocaquiti
accounts-lockout-info: Inin tlaahxitiliztin quiyecoa quen calaquiliztli tlayeyecoliztin mopalehuiah ica chicahuac tlayeyecoliztli.
accounts-lockout-known-users: Tlaahxitiliztin ixmatih tlacame (cuali tlacatoca, amo cuali tlatzaculmachiyotl)
accounts-lockout-unknown-users: Tlaahxitiliztin ahmo ixmatih tlacame (ahmo onca tlacatoca)
accounts-lockout-locked-users-info: Tlacame axcan tzacualloqueh ipampa miyac amo huelic calaquiliztli tlayeyecoliztin
admin-people-user-inactive: Tlacatl amo tequiti; xicpacho ic ticpehualtiz
cron-job-resume-failed: Amo huelic occepa mopehualtia tlanahuatilli tequitl
cron-no-failed-migrations: Amo onca amo huelic mijcueniliztli occepa moyeyecoz
cron-no-paused-migrations: Amo onca omoquetz mijcueniliztli occepa mopehualtiz
cron-migrations-retried: Amo huelic mijcueniliztin cuali occepa omoyeyecohqueh
filesystem-enabled-description: Xictequiti nican tlanamactlapixcalli ic mopiyaz tlanamactin
s3-minio-storage-description: S3-compatible object storage: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces and others.
s3-force-path-style-description: Monequi ipan MinIO ihuan miyac ahmo-AWS S3-monamictia teposcaltin.
azure-connection-string-description: Hueli: xictequiti mochi tlanamictiliztli tlahtolli ipatca tlapohualiztli itoca ihuan tepoztlatzquiliztli.
database-migration-description: Xicmijcueni tlahtolli tlamachiyotl (mochi intla ahmo tlanamictiltin ihuan ixiptlatzinmeh, yej mocahuah ipan tlanamactlapixcalli) nepantla MongoDB ihuan FerretDB v1 (SQLite). In occe tlahtolpixcalli monequi tequitiz ihuan huel ahciz (achto puertos: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; xicpatla ica WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ihcuac tlamiz, xicnexti MONGO_URL itech occe tlahtolpixcalli ihuan occepa xicpehualti WeKan (ipan Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb noso =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: ¿Xiquincopina mochtin tlahtolli nechicoliztin itech __db__? Tlanamictiltin ihuan ixiptlatzinmeh ipan tlanamactlapixcalli amo mopatlazqueh. Tlahtolpixcalli canin ahci monequi tequitiz.
sandstorm-migration-description: Ihcuac WeKan tequiti ihtec Sandstorm grain, ihuehcauh MongoDB 3 tlahtolpixcalli momijcuenia itech FerretDB v1 (SQLite) achto pehualizpan, ihuan tlanamictiltin ihuan ixiptlatzinmeh momijcueniah itech tlahtolpixcalli huan grain files/attachments ihuan files/avatars tlapiyalizcaltin. Inin quinextia intla mijcueniliztli cuali otlan ihuan quexquich tlalpan tlacoyan oc quitequitiah huehcauh raw MongoDB tlanamactin ihtec grain, ihuan mitzmacah ticpoloz raw tlanamactin ic ticcahuaz tlacoyan.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ihcuac mijcueniliztli cuali otlan, tlahtolli nemi ipan FerretDB ihuan tlanamactlapixcalli, yeca huehcauh raw MongoDB 3 tlahtolpixcalli tlanamactin huel mopolozqueh ic mocahuaz grain disco tlacoyan. Inin amo hueli mocuepaz.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: ¿Xiquinpolo raw MongoDB 3 tlahtolpixcalli tlanamactin ic ticcahuaz disco tlacoyan? Tlahtolli ye omijcuen itech FerretDB ihuan tlanamactlapixcalli. Inin amo hueli mocuepaz.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Raw MongoDB tlahtolpixcalli tlanamactin omopolohqueh, omocauh
cards-loading-description: WeKan isel quincalaquia huapalli amatlapaltin: ce hueyi huapalli (pan hueyiliztli itlamil) quincalaquia zan amatlapaltin axcan nezqui (ahmo tlami temoliztli) ihuan ce nemi tlapohualiztli, ic iciuhqui mocahua ihuan achi tlalnamiquiliztli ihuan tlanamictiliztli quitequitia; tzitzin huapaltin quincalaquiah mochtin amatlapaltin ic hueli mochi tlatequipanoliztli. Ahtle monequi motlaahxitiliz. Teyecanqueh oc huel quichicahuaz ce tlamantli ica CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ihuan CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD tlalticpac tlahtoltin.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Yolihui amatlapalli calaquiliztli ca tlayeyecolli: amatlapalli tlapohualtin ihuan WIP itlamil cuali, yece Calendar/Table/Gantt nezquiliztin ihuan miyac-pehpenaliztli quinextiah zan amatlapaltin ye ocalaquihqueh. Occepa xiquintlapo huapaltin ihcuac ticpatlaz inin.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ihcuac tequiti, mochtin tlanamictiltin (markdown tlanamictiltin quen [label](url) ihuan raw HTML <a href> machiyomeh) mochipa monextiah quen zan tlahtolli ahmo huel mopachoa ipan mochtin cualli tlahtolli tlaltin (huapalli ihuan amatlapalli tocameh, tlanonotzaltin, tlahtoltin, tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin, ihuan occe). Inin quitzacua tlacahcayahua tlanamictiltin. Achto amo tequiti, yeca tlanamictiltin huel mopachoah.
always-show-code-as-text: Mochipa xicnexti mochi tepoztlahtolli quen zan tlahtolli
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ihcuac tequiti, cualli tlahtolli ayic mochihua markdown noso HTML: mochi nelhuayotl mochipa monextia quen zan tlahtolli ipan mochtin cualli tlahtolli tlaltin (huapalli ihuan amatlapalli tocameh, tlanonotzaltin, tlahtoltin, tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin, ihuan occe). Inin quinextia tlatlatic tlahtolli — HTML tlahtoltin (<!-- -->), markdown tlanamictiltin itlamil, JavaScript ihuan occe tepoztlahtolli — yeca mochi tepoztlahtolli mochipa nezqui, ahmo mopachoa ihuan ahmo tequiti. Achto amo tequiti, yeca markdown momatqui mochihua.
disable-all-import-description: Ihcuac tequiti, mochtin calaquiliztli tlatequipanoliztin moquetzah: huapalli calaquiliztli itech WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ihuan Forgejo, noihqui huapalli copinaliztli. Calaquiliztli menu tlamantli motlatiah ihuan teposcalli quitzacua mochi calaquiliztli tlatlaniliztli. Achto amo tequiti.
disable-all-export-description: Ihcuac tequiti, mochtin quixtiliztli tlatequipanoliztin moquetzah: huapalli quixtiliztli quen WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, noso itech NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ihuan ce tlanamictilli quixtiliztli. Quixtiliztli menu tlamantli motlatiah ihuan teposcalli quitzacua mochi quixtiliztli tlatlaniliztli. Achto amo tequiti.
disable-import-avatars-description: Ihcuac tequiti, ixiptlatzinmeh (tlacatl ixiptlatzinmeh) ayic mocalaquiah. Inin quipia WeKan JSON calaquiliztli, Trello calaquiliztli ihuan ixiptlatzin namictiliztli itech caltenpan ixiptlatiloyan ihcuac calaquih (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Tocameh ihuan occe tlahtolli oc mocalaquia; zan ixiptlatzinmeh mopanahuiah. Achto amo tequiti.
disable-export-avatars-description: Ihcuac tequiti, ixiptlatzinmeh ayic mocaquitiah ihcuac moquixtia ce huapalli (WeKan JSON ihuan CSV quixtiliztli). Tlacatocameh ihuan occe tlahtolli oc moquixtia; zan ixiptlatzinmeh mopanahuiah. Achto amo tequiti.
anonymize-import-users-description: Ihcuac tequiti, ce WeKan JSON huapalli calaquiliztli quipatla cece calactoc tlacatl itlacatoca, itoca mochi ihuan achto tlahcuiloltin ica tlapohua tlacahuililtin (tlacatl1, tlacatl2, ...), quicahua ixiptlatzin ihuan quicuepa @tlacatoca tenehualtin (ihuan aquin quitlatlani / aquin quimaca tlaltin) ihtec calactoc amatlapalli ihuan tlahtolli tlahtolli. Ayac nelli tlacatl ixiptli itech nelhuayotl huapalli mopiya. In tlahtolli “tlacatl” quitoca itlahtol in aquin quicalaquia. Achto amo tequiti.
anonymize-export-users-description: Ihcuac tequiti, ce huapalli quixtiliztli quipatla cece quixtia tlacatl itlacatoca, itoca mochi ihuan achto tlahcuiloltin ica tlapohua tlacahuililtin (tlacatl1, tlacatl2, ...), quicahua ixiptlatzin ihuan quicuepa @tlacatoca tenehualtin (ihuan aquin quitlatlani / aquin quimaca tlaltin) ihtec amatlapalli ihuan tlahtolli tlahtolli. Quixtilli tlanamactli amo quihuica nelli tlacatl ixiptli. In tlahtolli “tlacatl” quitoca itlahtol in aquin quixtia. Achto amo tequiti.
disable-activities-description: Ihcuac tequiti, tequitl tlanonotzaltin ayic mopiyah ihuan ayic monextiah canah (huapalli tlaixpan ihuan amatlapalli tequitl tlapalli). Amo mopiya aquin tlen oquichih yehuacayotl. Achto amo tequiti.
disable-notifications-description: Ihcuac tequiti, WeKan ayic quititlani tlachiyaliztli tenahuatiltin (ihtec tequitiloyan, correo noso occe tlatequipanoliztin) ipampa ce tequitl. Tequitl oc huel mopiya (intla ahmo noihqui moquetza tlatzintlan); zan tenahuatiltin motzacuiliah. Achto amo tequiti.
disable-watch-description: Ihcuac tequiti, tlachiyaliztli tlatequipanoliztli moquetza — tlacame amo huel mocaquitiah itech huapaltin, tocatlahtoltin noso amatlapaltin ic quiselizqueh tenahuatiltin, ihuan mochi tlayeyecoliztli ic mopatlaz tlachiyaliztli tzacuilo. Achto amo tequiti.
backup-description: Xicpiya Tlanamictiltin, Ixiptlatzinmeh ihuan/noso Tlahtolli (mochtin tlahtolli nechicoliztin ahmo tlanamictiltin noso ixiptlatzinmeh). In .zip melahuac motitlani itech omopehpen tlapiyalizcalli — amo cahuitl tlanamactli — quen backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, quipia YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ihuan /data. Mixtli tlapiyalizcaltin (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) quitequitiah tlaahxitiliztin itech intlapiyaliz tlapaltin.
backup-scope-description: Mochi tequitiloyan, noso ce Nechicoliztli. Ce Nechicoliztli itlapiyaliz quipia ihuapaltin ihuan mochi ipan, noihqui in huapaltin intlanamictiltin — yece amo tlacatl tlapohualtin ihuan amo tequitiloyan tlaahxitiliztin, ica mochtin Nechicoliztin quimomachtiyah. Ce Nechicoliztli itlapiyaliz cuepaliztli zan quihcuiloa huapaltin in Nechicoliztli iaxcah.
backup-restore-select-first: Achto xicpehpena ce tlapiyaliztli itech tocatlahtolli.
backup-restore-confirm: ¿Xiccuepa omopehpen tlapiyaliztli? Tlanamictiltin/ixiptlatzinmeh moihcuiloah itech tlanamactlapixcalli ihuan tlahtolli itech tlahtolpixcalli quen omopehpen tlamantli.
gcs-key-filename-description: Hueli: ohtli itech tlatequipan tlapohualiztli JSON tepoztlatzquiliztli tlanamactli ipan teposcalli.
gcs-credentials-description: Hueli: xictlali tlatequipan tlapohualiztli JSON tepoztlatzquiliztli. Xiccahua cacahuac ic tictequitiz tepoztlatzquiliztli tlanamactli noso achto tlaahxitiliztin.
gcs-permissions-note: Xicmaca WeKan itlatequipan tlapohualiz amoxtiliztli/ihcuiloliztli ipan comitl: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → mocomitl → Permissions → Grant access. Ipan “New principals”, xictlali tlatequipan tlapohualiztli correo — “client_email” ipatiuh itech moJSON tepoztlatzquiliz — niman xicpehpena “Storage Object Admin” tequitl ihuan Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Xiccahua cacahuac ic ticpiyaz axcan ipatiuh.
gcs-bucket-description: Cloud Storage comitl itoca canin mopiyaz tlanamactin.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: xiccahua cacahuac (quitequitia tlalpan calaquiloyan). S3-monamictia: Endpoint URL itech mo MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces console.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → mocomitl → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → mocomitl itoca (noso Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → motlacatl → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → xicpehpena tequitl ‘Application running outside AWS’ → Create access key. Monextia quen ‘Access key ID’.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: San ce tlachiyaloni quen Access key ID; ‘Secret access key’ monextia zan ceppa ihcuac mochihua tepoztlatzquiliztli — axcan xiccopina (noso Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → motlapohualiz → itoca monextia ahco (noihqui itech Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → motlapohualiz → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → motlapohualiz → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → motlapohualiz → Data storage → Containers → motlapixcal (noso + Container ic ticchihuaz ce).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → tlatequitl pehpenaliztli ahco → motlatequitl ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → mocomitl itoca (noso Create ic ticchihuaz ce).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Ohtli ipan WeKan teposcalli huan motemohui tlatequipan tlapohualiztli JSON tepoztlatzquiliztli tlanamactli (mochihua tlatzintlan). Xictequiti inin NOSO xictlali JSON itech tlalli tlatzintlan.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → motlatequipan tlapohualiz → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (quitemohui tlanamactli). Xictlali nitlahtol nican, noso xicpiya tlanamactli ihuan xicahxiti iohtli ahco.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Xicmijcueni tlanamictilli itech Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Xicmijcueni tlanamictilli itech Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Xictequiti MongoDB GridFS ic mopiyaz tlanamactin
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Ic tlanamictiltin ihuan ixiptlatzinmeh monextizqueh, xiquinmijcueni itech CollectionFS huan occe Tlapiyalizcalli.
s3-access-key-description: AWS S3 calaquiliztli tepoztlatzquiliztli ic tlaneltiliztli
s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket name for storing files
s3-enabled-description: Xictequiti AWS S3 noso MinIO ic mopiyaz tlanamactin
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (e.g., s3.amazonaws.com or minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: AWS S3 ichtac tepoztlatzquiliztli ic tlaneltiliztli
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Quichihua mochi tlayeyecoliztin ihuan cualtiliztin ic huapalli tlahtolli cuali mocahuaz, noihqui tocatlahtolli tlatlaliliztli, amatlapalli incan ihuan ohtli itlamachiyotl.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Cuali quimpoloa cacahuac ome tocatlahtoltin. Zan quimpoloa tocatlahtoltin ahmo quipiah amatlapaltin IHUAN onca occe tocatlahtolli san ce itoca quipia amatlapaltin.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Quintemo ihuan quincuepa amatlapaltin ihuan tocatlahtoltin polihui swimlaneId noso listId. Quichihua ce ‘Polihui amatlapaltin’ ohtli ic mochtin polihui tlamantli occepa monextizqueh.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Quincuepa mochtin pixcalco ohtin, tocatlahtoltin ihuan amatlapaltin. Isel quicualtia mochi polihui swimlaneId noso listId ic tlamantli monextizqueh.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Quintemo ihuan quincualtia polihui noso tlahtlacoh tocatlahtoltin ipan huapalli itlamachiyotl.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Quinyancuicilia huapalli tlacameh inixiptlatzin URL ic quitequitizqueh cuali tlapiyalizcalli ihuan quicualtia tlahtlacoh ixiptlatzin tlanextiliztin.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Quinyancuicilia mochtin tlanamactli tlanamictilli URL ipan inin huapalli ic quitequitizqueh cuali tlapiyalizcalli ihuan quicualtia tlahtlacoh tlanamactli tlanextiliztin.
migrations-admin-only: Zan huapalli teyecanqueh huel quintequitiltiah mijcueniliztin
migrations-description: Xiquintequiti tlahtolli cualiliztli tlayeyecoliztin ihuan cualtiliztin ipan inin huapalli. Cece mijcueniliztli huel isel motequitiltia.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Inin quichihuaz mochi mijcueniliztli ic quitlatlatiz ihuan quicualtiz huapalli tlahtolli cualiliztli. Huel huehcahuaz tepitzin. ¿Xicontoca?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Inin achto quincuepaz mochtin momacehualtia tocatlahtoltin itech cece-ohtli tocatlahtoltin, niman quimpoloz cacahuac tocatlahtoltin quipiah occe san ce itoca tocatlahtolli quipia amatlapaltin. Zan melahuac ahmo monequi cacahuac tocatlahtoltin mopolozqueh. ¿Xicontoca?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Inin quichihuaz ce ‘Polihui amatlapaltin’ ohtli ihuan quincuepaz mochtin amatlapaltin ihuan tocatlahtoltin polihui swimlaneId noso listId. Inin zan quimpatla ahmo pixcalco tlamantli. ¿Xicontoca?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Inin quincuepaz MOCHTIN pixcalco ohtin, tocatlahtoltin ihuan amatlapaltin, ic occepa monextizqueh. Mochi tlamantli polihui ID isel mocualtiz. Inin amo ahuihqui mocuepaz. ¿Xicontoca?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Inin quintemoz ihuan quincualtiz polihui noso tlahtlacoh tocatlahtoltin ipan huapalli itlamachiyotl. ¿Xicontoca?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Inin quinyancuiciliz ixiptlatzin URL ipan huapalli tlacameh ic quitequitizqueh cuali tlapiyalizcalli. ¿Xicontoca?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Inin quinyancuiciliz mochtin tlanamactli tlanamictilli URL ipan inin huapalli ic quitequitizqueh cuali tlapiyalizcalli. ¿Xicontoca?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Amo onca polihui ohtli, tocatlahtolli noso amatlapalli mocuepaz
migration-progress-note: Ximochiya ihcuac ticmijcueniah mohuapalli itech yancuic itlamachiyotl…
conversion-info-text: Inin cuepaliztli mochihua ceppa ipan cece huapalli ihuan quicualtia iciuhquiliztli. Huel tictequitiz huapalli quen momatih.
converting-board-description: Mocuepa huapalli itlamachiyotl ic achi cuali tequitiz. Huel huehcahuaz tepitzin.
migration-batch-size-description: Tlanamictiltin tlapohualiztli motequitiz ipan cece nechicoliztli (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Xicquetza mijcueniliztli ihcuac CPU tequitiliztli quipanahuia inin porcentaje (10-90)
migration-info-text: Tlahtolpixcalli mijcueniliztin mochihuah ceppa ihuan quicualtiah tequitiloyan iciuhquiliztli. Tequitl contoca icuitlapan intla ticuahtzacuaz motlahcuiloloni.
migration-warning-text: Timitztlatlauhtia amo xicuahtzacua motlahcuiloloni ihcuac mijcueniliztli. Tequitl contocaz icuitlapan yece huel achi huehcahuaz ic tlamiz.
account-locked: Tlapohualiztli tzacua tepitzin ipampa miyac amo huelic calaquiliztli tlayeyecoliztin. Xicyeyeco occepa satepan.
problems-summary-help: Xiquinmachiotili tlahtlacolli tlaltin ye tiquittac, niman xicpacho Xicmati ic ticcuepaz inyancuic-tlahtlacolli tlapohualiz.
problems-in-progress-help: Inin mijcueniliztin noso cualtiliztin axcan tequitih. Calaquiliztin huel yolihuisqueh, noso quinextizqueh “Monequi ticalaquiz” noso ce “Mocalaquia, ximochiya” malacatl, hasta tlamizqueh ihuan CPU tzincuiz.
problems-none-in-progress: Amo onca mijcueniliztli noso cualtiliztli tequiti.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Omocualtih __fixed__ amatlapalli. __unfixable__ amatlapalli amo quipia huapalli ihuan amo huel isel mocualtia.
export-card-details: Amatlapalli tlanonotzaltin (cece amatlapalli quen amatlapalli quixtiliztli)
import-here-instruction: Xiccalaqui nican ce WeKan quixtiliztli (.json noso .zip):
import-board-source: Xiccalaqui huapalli (Trello, Jira, WeKan quixtiliztli, CSV, Excel, …)
import-parts-instruction: Zan machiyoh tlamantli mocalaquiah. San ce pehpenaliztli motequitia ihcuac moquixtia.
import-wekan-file: Xiccalaqui itech ce .json noso .zip quixtiliztli tlanamactli:
